target_series: England A&E attendances, Type 1 departments, monthly
data_source: NHS England Monthly A&E Time Series (published 8 Oct 2026); Open Government Licence v3.0
method: equal-weight average of ets_mul, sarima_masked, ridge_cx (rule declared in step 12)
intervals: 80% and 95%; empirical, from combo3's own past errors per horizon; error history excludes targets Mar 2020 - May 2022 (chosen after seeing step 11 results)
proof_step: reproduced the backtest forecast for origin 2024-09 within 0.0001
scoring_note: Score against actuals as NHS England publishes them (Oct 2026 data due 12 Nov 2026). Do not change this file after generation.
